description: A random walk that starts at one voltage and is steered so that it arrives exactly at another after a set time

params.text: Sets how much the walk wanders on its way, 0 for a straight ramp and 1 for the widest wander
Sets how far the walk ends from where it started, -10V to 10V
Sets the voltage the walk starts from, -10V to 10V
Sets how long the walk takes, two to the power of the knob setting in seconds

inputs.text: Adds to the range knob, one volt of range per volt
Adds to the offset knob, one volt of starting point per volt
Adds to the noise knob, a tenth of the knob's range per volt
Adds seconds to the time set by the time knob
A rising edge here starts a fresh walk from the offset voltage

outputs.text: Carries the walk, and holds at the far end once the walk has arrived

notes: the walk also restarts on its own whenever the total time changes, so turning the time knob or moving the time jack starts it again
the far end of the walk is the range knob added to the offset knob, not the range knob on its own
